subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supplier Development
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Supplier Development.

hook.text: A car maker sends its own engineers to a struggling supplier's factory. They fix the problem together.

buildup.text: Supplier development means actively helping suppliers improve their quality, processes, or capabilities.

discovery.text: It includes training, sharing best practices, co-investing in equipment, and joint problem-solving.

twist.text: It feels expensive—investing in someone else's business. But a better supplier means better products for you.

climax.text: Toyota's supplier development program is legendary—it builds world-class partners, not just vendors.

punchline.text: Help your suppliers improve and you improve too.
